gaps.term: scan cost claim missing array size
gaps.quote: a scan at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $\Theta(n\log n)$
gaps.note: Stated without the hypothesis that the array scanned has Theta(n) stored bits. A scan costs time proportional to V, so Theta(log n) scans cost Theta(n log n) only when V = Theta(n). The paper (line 90-91) says 'Scanning an array of $\Theta(n)$ stored bits at each of $\Theta(\log n)$ transform levels already costs $\Theta(n\log n)$'. The page never says what V is relative to n.
